idea-plugin.name: System Explorer
idea-plugin.description:
File browser plugin for IntelliJ-based IDEs. Local and remote (SSH/SFTP) browsing, fuzzy Quick Open with Lucene-backed content search, and a full Git panel — all without leaving the IDE.

Local Browser

  • Full filesystem tree with lazy directory loading and speed-search
  • File operations: copy, cut, paste, rename, delete (trash or permanent), new file/folder
  • Bookmarks sidebar — default Home/Desktop/Downloads, drag to reorder, right-click to remove
  • Glob filter bar with saved presets (e.g. *.kt, *.java;*.kt)
  • Multi-select, back/forward navigation, configurable default root path
  • VCS color coding: modified, added, deleted, renamed files highlighted in the tree
  • Status bar: item count, sizes, permissions (Unix/Mac); toggle hidden files and permissions inline
  • Context menu: Open, Open in System, Reveal in Finder, Open Terminal Here, Copy Path, Compare With…
  • Drag-and-drop: tree ↔ Project View, tree ↔ tree, external file manager → tree
  • Conflict detection and balloon notifications on drop errors

Quick Open — Cmd+Shift+P

  • Fuzzy search with frecency ranking (frequency + recency, configurable decay)
  • Query language: d: dirs, f: files, b: bookmarks, r: recent, > IDE actions, ~ regex, /: content search
  • Modifiers: @ext:EXT filter by extension, @in:PATH scope to directory
  • Lucene hybrid index for fast full-text content search (falls back to VFS enumeration)
  • Ripgrep content search (when rg is installed) with line-precise editor navigation and match highlighting
  • Speed dial on empty query (top frecency items, Cmd+1–Cmd+6)
  • Preview pane (Tab), recent query cycling (Ctrl+R), bookmark toggle (Cmd+D)
  • Teleport aliases: map short names to absolute paths in Settings
  • Index health dashboard: stats, rebuild, and index browser in Settings → Quick Open

Remote SSH Panels

  • Up to 4 SFTP panels with the same UI as the local browser
  • Full file operations (copy, cut, paste, rename, delete, new file/folder) over SFTP
  • Per-connection bookmarks, directory cache, and configurable keepalive/timeout settings
  • Remote Git status decorations on tree items when Remote Git integration is enabled
  • Drag-and-drop between local and remote panels; switch panels via Option+Shift+1–5

Git Panel

  • Commit log with graph, subject, date columns; filter by subject or author
  • Working-tree row shows uncommitted change count; click to inspect changes
  • Changed files list with status codes (M/A/D/R/C/?/U) and inline diff viewer
  • Stage/unstage files, write commit message, and push — all from the panel
  • Branch management: create, checkout, and delete branches; hard reset
  • Stash UI: create stash (with optional message and untracked), apply, and drop
  • Pull button with background task and three result paths (up to date, fast-forward, conflict)
  • Auto-detects local repos; tracks active browser tab to sync repo selector
  • Supports both local and remote (SSH) repositories

Keyboard Shortcuts

  • Alt+E — Toggle/focus System Explorer
  • Cmd+Shift+P — Quick Open
  • `c / `x / `v — Copy, cut, paste (backtick + key)
  • `r — Rename   `d — Delete   `f — Refresh
  • `y — Copy path   Enter — Open   Backspace — Go back   Alt+Left — Up one level
  • Option+Shift+1–5 — Switch to panel 1 (Local) or 2–5 (SSH); Ctrl+Alt+1–4 (Cmd+Alt on Mac) as alternative
  • `/ — Show shortcuts reference panel
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0

  • Chord shortcuts: backtick + key for context-aware file, Git panel and Quick Open actions
  • Shortcut reference tool window (`/), scrollable and resizable
  • Ctrl+Alt+1–4 (Cmd+Alt on Mac) as an alternative for panel switching; Alt+Left navigates up
  • Quick Open on remote SSH panels
  • Error notifications for index corruption, ripgrep failures and background crashes
  • Compatible with all IDE builds from 2025.1 onward
  • Fixed UI freezes, a drag-and-drop deadlock, file watcher crashes and several Lucene index issues

1.1.0

  • Remote SSH/SFTP panels: up to 4 remote browser panels with full file operations, bookmarks, and keepalive
  • Git Panel: commit log with graph, inline diff viewer, stage/commit/push workflow
  • Branch management: create, checkout, delete branches; hard reset
  • Stash UI: create (with message and untracked option), apply, and drop stashes
  • Pull button with background task; auto-detect local repos and sync with active browser tab
  • Quick Open v2: fuzzy popup with frecency ranking, query language, speed dial, and preview pane
  • Lucene hybrid index for fast content search; index health dashboard and index browser in Settings
  • Ripgrep content search (/: prefix) with line-precise editor navigation and match highlighting
  • Teleport aliases: short-name → absolute-path shortcuts in Quick Open
  • VCS color coding on local file tree (modified/added/deleted/renamed)
  • Remote Git status decorations on SSH tree items
  • Context menu additions: Reveal in Finder, Open Terminal Here, Compare With…
  • Drag-and-drop polish: ghost drag image, conflict pre-check, balloon notifications; external app drops
  • Panel switching shortcuts: Option+Shift+1–5
  • Many additional settings: sort options, status bar detail levels, file permissions display, and more

1.0.0

  • Full filesystem browser with tree view, file operations, bookmarks, glob filter, and status bar
  • Drag-and-drop with Project View; context menu with all file operations
  • Quick Open path dialog; configurable settings and keyboard shortcuts
